Welcome back to Life On Wheels Studios!
In this video, we bring you another detailed ground update from the *Urga–Pathalgaon Section of the Raipur–Dhanbad Economic Corridor (NH-130)* in Chhattisgarh.
This time, we explore the highway from the Pathalgaon side, travelling towards Urga, & take a closer look at the latest construction progress across different stretches.
A major portion of this highway is now visibly complete, while some construction activities are still underway.
